objective.statement: On HomeView.tsx, change the greeting text "Hello ADA" to read "Your imagination, realised".

complexity.rationale: One literal string in one component, explicit behaviour, localized scope, no approval-boundary or contract change.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: HomeView renders the text "Your imagination, realised".
HomeView no longer renders the text "Hello ADA".

in.statement: The greeting heading text in src/views/home/HomeView.tsx and the matching assertion in src/views/home/HomeView.component.test.tsx.

out.statement: Any other HomeView content, styling, markup level, or other views.

observations.statement: The heading element (h3) and its position stay unchanged; only the text changes. The existing greeting test is updated rather than a new one added.

provenance.source: Card text: change the text on HomeView.tsx that reads "Hello ADA" to "Your imagination, realised"
Conservative planning decision by the delivery engineer

capabilityOwners.rationale: The change is a literal string; no state is involved.
No API or server data is touched.
HomeView owns the greeting heading markup.

component.rationale: Rendered text is observable behaviour of HomeView, tested in HomeView.component.test.tsx.

integration.rationale: No cross-module or API interaction changes.

e2e.rationale: Static text change fully covered by the component test.

increments.behavior: HomeView greets with "Your imagination, realised" instead of "Hello ADA".
increments.doneWhen: The updated component test passes and the existing HomeView tests still pass.

tests.description: should greet with Your imagination, realised and not render Hello ADA
